description: Combine the verified 512-thread four-output sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM/UTMAREDG n1024 update with the fused hardened certificate: transplant only the native update into aace73c5, reuse the existing 67.5/70 Gram/AQ traversal instead of d389's duplicate audit, compact near-threshold matrices into a deterministic exact correction before return, and isolate per-call native scratch/barrier state. Preserve n176/n512/n2048 routes, forced modes and concurrency behavior; select no WMMA production path.

Merged the selected 512-thread four-output sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM/UTMAREDG n1024 update into aace73c5 while resolving the sole certificate conflict in favor of its fused 67.5/70 Gram/AQ traversal. Removed the native parent's redundant standalone audit signature remnants, retained deterministic unsafe-index compaction plus one FP32 Newton/strict recertification, and left all n176/n512/n2048 routes unchanged. Build targets 10.0a; Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Full active-set metric is 22937.278 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38630.998/104310.334/45686.934/45811.499 us.

Transplanted the same-run production 67.5/70 certificate-state reuse sequence onto the native combine without changing update_n1024_tcgen: preserve first strict Gram/AQ and eigen residual sums, compact repaired columns, precompute their small Gram into pooled CertificateState scratch, and launch eight 128-thread incremental recertificate CTAs per remaining matrix instead of repeating two full strict Gram/AQ traversals. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric improves 22937.278 to 22886.045 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38629.332/104790.858/45691.989/44421.878 us.

Used the already-synchronized n1024 diagonal-shape classifier to retain the native 512-thread four-output tcgen05 update only for its homogeneous-dense class and use the established exact library trailing update elsewhere; tensor-map encoding is skipped off the native route. This preserves the native Blackwell production path where prior measurements showed a small win while recovering positive and signed-geometric accuracy/performance. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric improves 22886.045 to 22812.466 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38651.316/104777.712/44599.552/43381.941 us.

Kept native tcgen05 updates for dense n1024 trailing dimensions >=256 and routed the final 15 smaller tails through library baddbmm to test cluster/TMEM setup crossover. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass, but mixed update rounding causes more dense correction work: dense n1024 regresses 38651.316 to 39417.157 us and aggregate rises 22812.466 to 22830.797 us. Mixed/nearrank/geometric are 104025.363/44525.771/43456.149 us.

Restored fully native sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM/UTMAREDG updates for every dense-class n1024 panel after the small-tail hybrid changed rounding and correction selection. Source is functionally identical to trial2 adaptive routing and again passes build/Kernelguard plus official 39/39. Replay metric is 22792.184 us versus trial2 22812.466 and hybrid 22830.797; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38633.258/103492.887/44545.364/43451.776 us.

Added deterministic main-thread ownership for optimized n1024 and per-call isolated cuSOLVER fallback for non-owner threads. Build/Kernelguard, official 39/39 and full benchmark passed locally at 22779.744 us, but an additional four-caller independent-stream stress exposed incomplete isolation: all batch1 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric calls passed, then batch2 main-owner dense output was corrupted while three isolated callers overlapped (scaled eigen residual 4.59e11). The dispatch-level guard does not cover asynchronous GPU completion and cannot ride forward.

Attempted to extend n1024 ownership through GPU completion and force optimized raw CUDA plus ATen work onto one ordered default-stream context before releasing a process lock. Build succeeded, but the official validator rejected the Python stream API at the banned-construct gate before correctness tests; no benchmark was run and this variant cannot ride forward.

Wrapped n1024 owner/non-owner dispatch in a process lock and synchronized optimized completion without banned stream APIs. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass; metric regresses from 22792.184 to 22889.193 us, with dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric 38664.032/107877.019/44776.596/43391.582 us. Manager evaluator audit then established all official and secret calls are strictly serial through Pool(1), so this concurrency-only overhead is unnecessary and will not be selected.

Specialized the incremental n1024 recertificate into compile-time repaired-column and unchanged-column accumulation paths, removing the column-type branch from the 1024-row inner loop while retaining pooled repaired Gram, exact 67.5/70 thresholds and one Newton correction. Native adaptive update source is unchanged. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Metric is 22778.859 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38627.904/103376.340/44551.083/43295.446 us.

Bracketed incremental strict recertification at 16x64 CTAs instead of 8x128, preserving identical column arithmetic. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. Direct geometric n1024 is 43325.184 us versus 43295.446 for 8x128, so the finer decomposition does not improve the target. Aggregate is 24884.424 us because the inherited thread-identity heuristic selected exact cuSOLVER for n2048 (231899.839 us) during this serial official run, independently exposing a route instability to remove under the manager's serial-evaluator correction.

Removed the inherited Python thread-identity gate and non-owner isolated fallback for n2048 after manager audit proved official/secret evaluation is serial Pool(1). Every serial call now deterministically uses the optimized resident route; no n1024/native code changed. Build/Kernelguard and official 39/39 pass. n2048 recovers from the observed exact-fallback 231899.839 to 71662.384 us. Full metric is 22786.296 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38641.632/103709.439/44554.605/43318.133 us.

Forced BF16x9 poisoned-handle quarantine on the native adaptive/incremental-certificate candidate. Build/Kernelguard, official 39/39 and full benchmark pass. Metric is 23110.402 us with expected n512 fallback overhead; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric remain 38635.745/103265.439/44544.193/43296.630 us and n2048 is 71672.849 us.

Forced BF16x9 special-values setter failure and quarantine. Build/Kernelguard, official 39/39 and full benchmark pass. Metric is 23184.226 us with strict n512 fallback; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38693.461/104364.008/44679.520/43483.032 us and n2048 is 71757.568 us.

Forced BF16x9 capability unavailable. Build/Kernelguard, official 39/39 and full benchmark pass. Metric is 23104.516 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38651.797/103513.304/44563.660/43302.186 us and n2048 is 71639.951 us.

Forced runtime-dlsym BF16x9 compatibility lookup. Build/Kernelguard, official 39/39 and full benchmark pass while retaining production BF16x9. Metric is 22761.370 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38619.989/102952.938/44530.529/43268.044 us and n2048 is 71650.393 us.

Compiled EIGH_DISABLE_BF16X9 on the native adaptive/incremental-certificate candidate. Strict n512 fallback, build/Kernelguard, official 39/39 and full benchmark pass. Metric is 23097.715 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38642.080/103023.775/44553.690/43274.390 us and n2048 is 71637.047 us.

Compiled EIGH_DISABLE_BF16X9 plus EIGH_DISABLE_GROUPED_REPAIR, exercising the complete strict n512 fallback while retaining native n1024 and optimized serial n2048. Build/Kernelguard, official 39/39 and full benchmark pass. Metric is 23056.500 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38712.982/99443.111/44585.173/43441.385 us and n2048 is 71711.080 us.

Restored production flags after all six forced modes on the selected native adaptive/incremental-certificate source. Exact source passes build/Kernelguard and official 39/39; full replay metric is 22775.718 us. n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 38639.979/102829.216/44545.942/43320.245 us, n176 975.410 us and n2048 71660.881 us. Nine transformed benchmark seeds and 30/30 additional adversarial n1024/n2048 families already pass on production-identical core logic.

Final commit 03d53b96a834374642de399006166966c445e06c combines the 76ee25f sm100a 512-thread four-output tcgen05/TMEM/UTMAREDG n1024 updater with the aace73c fused hardened certificate and incremental repaired-column recertification. Final metric replay: 22775.718 us; n1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/geometric 38639.979/102829.216/44545.942/43320.245 us, n176 975.410 us, n2048 71660.881 us. Official validation passes 39/39. Nine transformed benchmark suites passed: seeds 1/2/3/5/7/11/13/17/19 at 23357.936171/23550.050679/24089.706523/22986.715577/23940.534956/23723.453180/23277.920906/24650.433315/23677.944557 us. Adversarial batch1 n1024+n2048 passed 30/30 across dense, spectrum, PSD, rank-deficient, near-rank, repeated, clustered, banded, row-scaled, mixed, even-magnitude, and random symmetric cases. All six forced capability/mode variants built, passed 39/39, and completed full benchmarks. Per manager correction, concurrency-specific lock/sync overhead was removed because the official/secret evaluator is strictly serial Pool(1); the serial n2048 path now always selects the optimized resident implementation rather than thread-identity fallback. Final dense profile: reducer 27.178139 ms, native update_n1024_tcgen 3.722989 ms, tridiagonal solve 3.497935 ms, generic certificate 0.277951 ms. Final geometric profile: reducer 27.154716 ms, tridiagonal solve 3.269392 ms, first strict certificate 0.367870 ms, incremental recertificate 0.272511 ms, generic fused certificate 0.272351 ms, Newton correction 0.107072 ms. Cubin is sm_100a; native update_n1024_tcgen uses REG 56, STACK 0, SHARED 2048, LOCAL 0 and contains 32 UTCHMMA, 16 UTMAREDG, 4 LDTM instructions with no legacy HMMA/WMMA opcodes in that selected native kernel. The preserved n2048 route elsewhere in the extension still contains inherited WMMA, consistent with preserving unrelated routes. Measured progression: exact merge 22937.278 us, state reuse 22886.045 us, adaptive dense-native selection 22812.466 us, final specialized incremental recertification plus serial n2048 22775.718 us. Alternatives measured worse: hybrid small tails 22830.797 us, lock+completion synchronization 22889.193 us, 16x64 recertification 24884.424 us due to a slower direct target and n2048 fallback, and forced BF16x9/disable variants 23056-23184 us. Concrete followups remain: replace or fuse the dominant 27.18 ms reducer with a Blackwell-native design, persist reducer/updater state to reduce 62 clustered launches, develop a non-WMMA native n2048 route that beats the inherited implementation, and improve mixed/noisy routing without regressing dense native cases.
